name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: Iran calls US reply to its Hormuz plan unconvincing; US hits Qeshm; IRGC claims tanker mine strikes
state: Iran's security council called the US reply to its Hormuz plan unconvincing on 3 Nov; Iran proposes reopening the strait over two days if sanctions and the US naval blockade are lifted. Trump confirmed a strike on an air-defence site on Qeshm Island on 3 Nov, calling it 'minor' (Al Jazeera). The IRGC claimed four tankers hit mines on 4 Nov. Iran's negotiator welcomed the US midterm result on 4 Nov; talks continue (AP).
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states. Flights in the region may be rerouted or cancelled at short notice.
rubric_hit: Active US–Iran strikes and Hormuz substantially closed = Alert

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran says US reply to Hormuz plan 'unconvincing'; Trump confirms strikes
AP via KRMG — Iranians celebrate setback for Trump in US election, and other Mideast news

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
